sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the direct UIWL and DUI requirements, preserves conditional case applicability without an unconditional relationship requirement, validates the declared owners, datatypes, and metric-kilotonne units, and checks DUI against the greatest represented case displacement using the required expected-value-scaled tolerance. Deterministic validation is valid and no vocabulary repair is needed.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Do not make hasUpperIceWaterlineCase sh:minCount 1 unconditionally. The requirement makes the linked waterline-case selection applicable only where multiple waterlines are used; preserve the direct DUI/UIWL requirement while conditionally applying the case relationship and greatest-displacement checks, so a single-waterline case is not rejected merely for lacking a case node. Implement a bounded max-selection check that remains vacuous when no case is represented and rejects any DUI outside the permitted tolerance of the greatest represented waterline-case displacement.
